svg.desc: Wide Frutiger Aero vector software wallpaper: a peaceful lavender twilight sky fading to pale rose above a reflective lake, soft white clouds, glasslike translucent bubbles and subtle luminous arcs clustered near the edges, distant violet hills. Dreamy optimistic 2000s aesthetic with smooth gradients and clean contours. Keep the center spacious and low contrast for readable software content. Full bleed, no text, no logo, no border, no interface or panels.
